judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `sessions`) instead of the issue's specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `conversations`. It also directly violates several explicit design rules and acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config altogether, omits `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` and `StoreCannotList`, and returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is unimplemented instead of returning an error. Validation of `limit` allows `0` and values over `200`, contrary to the 1–200 requirement. Finally, it fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff.
